pairs.summary: FOS::JUN and NR2C1 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 4 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; A549 lung adenocarcinoma; MDA-MB-468 triple-negative breast cancer; Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Macrophage (General)). Median lift 1.29x, typical spacing ~63 bp between sites. In 4 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. Caution: dimer motif — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
